disease_label_per_paper: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia with DAT positive for C3 and negative for IgG
presentation_summary: 79-year-old woman with dementia was found unresponsive and referred after outside hospital hemoglobin 3.6 g/dL, hyperbilirubinemia, and positive Coombs test.
She received 4 units at the outside hospital, but at the tertiary hospital hemoglobin was 2.6 g/dL and she required ICU admission for transfusion and close monitoring.
Initial LDH was 442 U/L and unconjugated bilirubin was 10 mg/dL.
Peripheral smear showed spherocytes, polychromasia, and reticulocytosis.
DAT was positive for C3 alone and negative for IgG, IgA, and IgM; cold agglutinin screen and eluate were negative.
She later transitioned to palliative care and died after a few days.
